source_basis: Directed weighted passing network using igraph — vertices are players, edges are passes with frequency weights. Standard SNA construction applied to football domain.
interpretation: Network construction from event data is a transferable modeling pattern for any interaction-based system.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Dyad analysis: 46 'double pass' (bidirectional) vs 280 'single pass' (unidirectional) configurations. Quantifies reciprocity in the network.
interpretation: Dyad reciprocity ratio as a metric is reusable for any directed network analysis.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Triad analysis: 16 combinations of 3-vertex subgraphs used as network motifs. References graph.motifs() from igraph.
interpretation: Triad census / network motif analysis applicable to MCM problems involving interaction networks.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Four network metrics extracted: clustering coefficient (flow), closeness centrality (flexibility), dispersion (spatial spread), shortest path (hierarchy). Each mapped to a team behavior interpretation.
interpretation: Metric-to-interpretation mapping is a reusable pattern: compute network statistic → assign behavioral meaning.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: AHP used for subjective weight assignment with CR<0.1 consistency check. Standard MCDM technique applied to player action valuation.
interpretation: AHP is a common MCM technique; always report CR value for credibility.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Entropy weight method for objective weighting — information entropy measures data dispersion, higher dispersion = higher weight. Complementary to AHP's subjective approach.
interpretation: AHP+entropy fusion is a powerful MCM pattern for combining expert judgment with data-driven weighting.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Equal-weight average of AHP and entropy weights. Simple but lacks theoretical justification — sensitivity analysis not provided.
interpretation: When fusing subjective/objective weights, document the fusion rationale and ideally test sensitivity to fusion method.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Logistic regression with 13 IVs spanning 4 categories (individual, structure, strategy, environment). Comprehensive but sample-to-variable ratio (76:13 ≈ 5.8:1) below the 10:1 guideline.
interpretation: In MCM papers, acknowledge sample-to-variable ratio explicitly; judges check this.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: VIF used for multicollinearity detection with VIF>10 threshold, followed by stepwise regression correction.
interpretation: VIF + stepwise is a common MCM diagnostic-correction pattern, but stepwise is unstable in small samples.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Heterogeneity analysis: split by opponent formation type and re-run regression per subgroup. Shows formation effectiveness is opponent-conditional.
interpretation: Subgroup/heterogeneity regression is a powerful MCM technique for showing interaction effects.
applicability: Transferable to MCM problems requiring network analysis or regression modeling.

source_basis: Four-verb gerund chain as abstract framework: 'identifying-expanding-exploring-putting forward'. Progressive escalation from description to prescription.
interpretation: Gerund chain openings are a distinctive human MCM abstract pattern.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'With the arrival of the big data era' — temporal framing that justifies method feasibility. Common in Chinese-authored MCM papers.
interpretation: Era-framing is a human MCM language pattern that AI models rarely produce.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'embodied in the performance of' — distinctly non-native but widespread MCM collocation. Human signal: AI would write 'reflected in' or 'manifested through'.
interpretation: Track 'embodied in' as a human MCM idiom for the language-imitation skill.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'It can be seen from the table that' — the single most common MCM evidence-citing phrase. Appears naturally and repeatedly in human-authored papers.
interpretation: This phrase is a critical human MCM marker; the skill must include it.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'Due to the overlapping of content and the limitation of space, we do not show each game one by one' — classic MCM space-limitation apology. Human-distinctive.
interpretation: Space-limitation apology is uniquely human; AI never self-limits due to 'page constraints'.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'which also proves the validity of the model' — cumulative evidence marker. Human tell: 'also proves' implies stacking evidence from multiple tests.
interpretation: Cumulative validity claims ('also proves', 'further confirms') are human MCM closing patterns.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'can be extended to' repeated 7+ times in extension section. Mechanical repetition as deliberate rhetorical strategy for systematic analogy-mapping.
interpretation: Repetitive parallel structure in extension sections is a human MCM pattern; AI would vary phrasing.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'It is worth mentioning that' — self-highlighting move. Distinctly human MCM phrase rarely generated by AI.
interpretation: 'It is worth mentioning that' belongs in the human-idiom library.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'The analysis level is clear, the results are stable, and the conclusions and suggestions are practical' — triple parallel quality claim. Mirror structure for self-evaluation.
interpretation: Triple-parallel self-assessment is a human MCM conclusion pattern.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: 'Under the controllable environment of football matches' — qualifying scope before claiming model strength. 'Controllable environment' is Chinese-influenced formal register.
interpretation: Scope-qualifying openings with Chinese-influenced register are authenticity markers.
applicability: Reusable language pattern for human-style MCM paper writing.

source_basis: VIF multicollinearity test explicitly reported with 'serious multicollinearity' found. Paper honestly reports the problem before fixing it.
interpretation: Reporting diagnostics honestly (even when results are bad) strengthens paper credibility.
applicability: Applicable to any MCM model validation or diagnostic reporting.

source_basis: Consistency index CR<0.1 check for AHP. Standard but exact CR value not reported.
interpretation: Always report exact CR value, not just pass/fail.
applicability: Applicable to any MCM model validation or diagnostic reporting.

source_basis: Robustness check via expanding offensive style from 3 to 5 categories. Results remain significant, supporting robustness.
interpretation: Robustness checks via variable re-specification are a strong MCM validation technique.
applicability: Applicable to any MCM model validation or diagnostic reporting.

source_basis: 96.1% prediction accuracy claimed but appears to be in-sample. No train-test split or cross-validation mentioned.
interpretation: In-sample accuracy without CV is a common MCM weakness; flag it in formula-error-watch.
applicability: Applicable to any MCM model validation or diagnostic reporting.

source_basis: Counterintuitive finding: ball possession rate negatively affects results. Paper explains as 'high possession may reflect slow pace'. This is speculative but demonstrates willingness to challenge conventional wisdom.
interpretation: Explaining counterintuitive findings shows analytical depth; don't just report surprising coefficients.
applicability: Relevant to logical consistency in MCM argumentation.

source_basis: Time dimension explored (Section 4.3) with line graphs showing temporal strategy shifts, but temporal features never enter the regression model. Logical disconnect between analysis and modeling.
interpretation: Every analysis section should feed into the main model, or explicitly justify why not.
applicability: Relevant to logical consistency in MCM argumentation.

source_basis: R² 'close to 1' for logistic regression with small sample is a strong overfitting signal. Paper does not acknowledge this.
interpretation: Reusable pattern or finding for MCM skill accumulation.
applicability: Warning pattern to avoid in future MCM papers.
counterevidence: Paper acknowledges limitations in strengths-weaknesses section.

source_basis: 96.1% in-sample accuracy without cross-validation. Standard ML practice requires held-out test set.
interpretation: Reusable pattern or finding for MCM skill accumulation.
applicability: Warning pattern to avoid in future MCM papers.
